prompts.title: Forma reciente: victorias, empates y derrotas
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, roughly 7 seconds adapted to the narration, on GoatLab charcoal #101412 with warm white #edf0e6, lime #c5ed74 and slate #8ca6bf. The lower quarter stays clear for permanent lime-yellow subtitles in Spanish. EDITORIAL VARIANT (first block, kinetic typography): the headline 'FORMA RECIENTE' enters letter by letter on a hard staccato rhythm, letters landing with a 1–2 frame overshoot; 'ESCOCIA' then 'ESLOVENIA' slam in beneath on each spoken accent, each team name underlined by a lime wipe that runs left to right. One focal point: the type stack, centred in the upper three quarters. A slate diagonal shard crosses the frame as the transition between team beats, and the exit is a rising slate bar wiping the typography off screen. No statistical axes, no sample claims and no invented match events here. STATISTICAL VARIANT (second block): grouped count bars in three groups labelled 'VICTORIAS', 'EMPATES', 'DERROTAS', two bars per group — Escocia in lime, Eslovenia in slate — sharing one zero baseline and one common scale from 0 to {{home.n}} partidos with unit ticks. Bars grow upward from the baseline in sequence over 0.8 seconds. Spanish labels under each group, axis title 'partidos', and a source/sample annotation pinned just above the subtitle band: 'Muestra: {{home.n}} / {{away.n}} partidos · Fuente: Bzzoiro · Bzzoiro'. Main comparison: the DERROTAS group, where {{home.losses}} against {{away.losses}} diverges; emphasis by lifting that group with a lime outline and a soft glow while the others dim to slate. Secondary readings {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}} count up as numerals above their bars. Camera: slow push-in on the emphasised group, then a gentle pull-back revealing the whole chart. Transition between variants: a lime horizontal bar sweep. Exit: bars retract to the baseline and the frame fades to charcoal.

Kinetic captions 'GOLES A FAVOR' and 'GOLES RECIBIDOS' fade up in warm white at each path peak, giving one focal point per beat.
